IGST Settlement Summary

Source: R/functions.R
igst_settlement_summary.Rd

Retrieve and aggregate IGST settlement data to states.

igst_settlement_summary(
  financial_year = NULL,
  state = NULL,
  by = c("state", "region", "national")
)

Arguments

financial_year

character vector. NULL = all.

state

character vector. NULL = all.

by

character(1). "state" (default), "region", or "national".

Value

A data.table with regular, adhoc, and total IGST settlement.

Examples

igst_settlement_summary(financial_year = "2023-24", by = "state")[order(-total)][1:10]
#>     financial_year         state  region  regular     adhoc    total
#>             <char>        <char>  <char>    <num>     <num>    <num>
#>  1:        2025-26   Maharashtra    West 70174.98     0.000 70174.98
#>  2:        2024-25   Maharashtra    West 58609.65     0.000 58609.65
#>  3:        2024-25 Uttar Pradesh Central 49418.53     0.000 49418.53
#>  4:        2023-24   Maharashtra    West 49389.45 -1117.800 48271.65
#>  5:        2025-26 Uttar Pradesh Central 47236.00     0.000 47236.00
#>  6:        2023-24 Uttar Pradesh Central 45273.08 -1158.300 44114.78
#>  7:        2022-23   Maharashtra    West 39726.63  3531.462 43258.09
#>  8:        2022-23 Uttar Pradesh Central 36674.52  1879.530 38554.05
#>  9:        2024-25     Karnataka   South 37493.77     0.000 37493.77
#> 10:        2025-26     Karnataka   South 36526.58     0.000 36526.58
